AGENT’S HANDBOOK

A brief case briefing.

  1. Choose your case. The number tells you how many letters are in its secret word.
  2. Work the lock. Each wheel has five consecutive letters that loop. Swipe up or down, drag with a mouse, or tap the upper or lower letters. No arrows. No move limit.
  3. Try your code. Nothing happens until you press Try the lock. Wrong guesses just rattle the lock. Keep going.
  4. Call Field Control. Request intel for a clue. It halves your points once, not every time you read it.
GoldUnder 5 minutes10 points
Silver5–10 minutes6 points
Bronze10 minutes or more4 points

There’s no deadline. Hints halve points, not your medal. Time runs from opening a case, including time away. Your case and field record are saved on this device when browser storage is available.

Keyboard: Tab to a wheel, use ↑/↓ to turn it and ←/→ to change wheels. Enter tries the lock. A wheel can wrap through Z and A, but always loops through its own five letters.
